hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the gate out is south

spots.line: A garden square, kept by people who will not say which of them keeps it.
The walk. Copied out here in good light until the light goes.
Names cut into the wall in a column, and the column has run out of wall.
Every arch has a different beast on it. Nobody has explained the beasts.
Somebody is singing two rooms away and stops when you listen.

chests.line: A press of spare quires, ruled and never written on.
The almoner's box. It is not locked, which says something about the house.

people.name: Sister Anwen
chatter: We copy in the walk because the light is better and the talk is worse.
The garden is older than the house. The house was put around it.
Ask for a book by what it is about. Nobody here knows the titles.
You may sit. You may not take a candle into the presses.

people.name: Brother Cadfan
chatter: Forty-one years on the same shelf of it. I am nearly at the end of the first half.
My hand is going. I am training a boy who is worse than me and getting better.
They ring for meals. You will hear it. Everyone hears it.

people.name: a boy sent to fetch ink
chatter: He is not fetching ink. He is going the long way about not fetching ink.
He asks if you have been anywhere, and does not wait for the answer.
